description: Bounded exclusion of EP2 over the searched atlas domain. The bound is on the scale-free root separation |a1/a2| and on the pairwise branch gap; it is NOT based on |dF/domega|, which is not invariant under rescaling of the spectral condition and therefore cannot bound anything.

domain.naming_note: z_minus = r_minus^2; prior work's r2 is r_minus. The guard z_minus<=0.20 means r_minus<=0.447, but the atlas actually reaches r_minus=0.2287.

verdict: No EP2 in the searched domain. Branch gap >= 0.5116, scale-free root separation >= 0.3107, min |D| >= 0.2618, condition number at the strongest interaction 8.73e3 (finite). The ten tightest candidates were rejected by the EP gate: G2/G3 pass (two distinct roots present) while G1/G4/G6 fail (no coalescence, no monodromy exchange, no square-root splitting) -- i.e. avoided crossings.
limitations: minimum attained on the box boundary (s=0.42, delta=-0.20, mu=1.8)
mu > 1.8 covered only by a targeted probe, not by the atlas
quasiresonant regime not searched: Solvers C/D inapplicable by formulation
overtones N>3 and higher l not searched
bounded numerical exclusion over a declared domain, NOT a theorem
